verdict.rationale: Thoropass is a compliance automation platform, so per-employee workstation compliance tracking is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only documents general integrations and monitors for cloud systems such as AWS, Azure and GCP. Nothing in the pack mentions an endpoint agent, an MDM integration, or per-employee checks for disk encryption, screen lock or password managers, so the cloud monitors are adjacent rather than this capability.

support.subject: As an IT admin, workstation compliance is tracked per employee — disk encryption, screen lock, password manager — via an agent or MDM integration
